title: See what any single DNA change does to your body
title_candidates: What Google's AI found when it checked all 9 billion possible DNA mutations
Google's AI can now predict what any single DNA change does to your body
The AI database that tells you what every possible DNA mutation means
How Google DeepMind mapped the impact of 9 billion DNA changes in one tool
The moment Google's AI looked at every possible DNA mutation at once
caption:
Google DeepMind just built an AI that maps all 9 billion ways a single DNA letter can change, and what each one does.

Any researcher can now search a specific mutation and instantly see how it affects gene activity, protein binding, and cell behavior. Testing even one of those mutations in a lab used to take weeks. The Atlas covers every position in the human genome, all at once, for free.

It runs on the same biology engine that powers AlphaFold, the AI that already cracked the protein-folding problem science spent 50 years on.
